meta.ratingsNote: batting and bowling ratings are informal estimates (0-100) for game balance, not official IPL or ICC ratings. Swap this file to use your own pool.
meta.currency: All bids and base prices are in points. Every player has a flat base price of 2 points.
meta.nomination: The auction queue is a full random shuffle of the pool so stars and weaker known names appear in mixed order.
meta.headshots: Official IPL headshot URLs from www.iplt20.com (team-assets), matched offline by name/slug. See scripts/map-headshots.js. The client hotlinks these; images are not rehosted.
